name: India · ICSE / ISC (CISCE)
notes: English-forced best-of-N selection, NOT plain averages. ICSE Class 10: English + best 4 others (best 5 of 6). ISC Class 12: English + best 3 others (best 4).

presets.label: ICSE Class 10 · English + best 4 of the rest
presets.note: Percentage = (best 5 subjects ÷ 500) × 100, English compulsorily included; lowest other subject dropped. Pass: 33% per subject (written + internal separately). No CGPA.

presets.label: ISC Class 12 · English + best 3 of the rest
presets.note: Aggregate = (English + best 3 others) ÷ 4 × 100 · Best of 4, NOT 5. Divisions: Distinction ≥75%, First 60–74.99%, Pass 35–59.99%.

sources.label: Collegedunia · ICSE Class X grading system

traps: ISC is Best of 4 (English + best 3), NOT best of 5.
Pass is 35%/subject (ISC from 2024; ICSE 33%) · 40% on outdated pages is wrong.
